name: Top-down action (move, aim, shoot)
pitch: A small garden robot hoses down thorn creatures that creep into a walled garden in waves, then faces a large final creature.
camera: from above, tilted, follows the player
controls: WASD or arrows to move, mouse to aim, hold the left button to fire, Space to dash. Gamepad: sticks move and aim, RT fires, A dashes.
use_when: any game where you look down on a character: twin-stick shooters, arena survival, dungeon crawlers, tower defence seen from above, top-down adventure, herding or cleaning games.
not_for: first-person games, side-on platformers, racing, flying, games with jumping between heights
already_good: Movement that starts and stops at once, with mouse or right-stick aiming
Forgiving shooting: wide hit radius, aim magnetism, shots that land where you point
A short dash with safe frames, buffering and a cooldown shown at your feet
Three enemy kinds, each warning on the ground before it can hurt, plus a boss with four readable attacks
Waves as a table and the arena as a text map, with collision and path-finding
Pickups that fly to you with a rising chime, and an end card that says what got you
